title: NavIC Kya Hai? 🛰️ Bharat Ka Apna GPS Phir Se Mazboot! 5 Facts #shorts
description:
NavIC kya hai? Bharat ka apna GPS – ISRO ke NVS-03 satellite ke saath phir se mazboot! 🛰️🇮🇳
NavIC aur NVS-03 launch ki poori kahani 5 facts mein.

30 Oct, raat 11:51 – GSLV-F18 launch • NavIC phir se 4 working satellites par • India + border se 1,500 km aage tak coverage • Naya L1 signal, mobile phones ke liye aasan • 420 ton ka rocket, GSLV ki 20th udaan

Aap GPS par bharosa karoge ya desi NavIC par? Comment karo! 👇
